description: This file defines utility functions and types for handling model cost configurations, usage estimation, and caching related to AI model pricing within the openclaw project.

methods.name: formatTokenCount
methods.description: Formats a number of tokens into a human-readable string with 'k' or 'm' suffix.

methods.name: formatUsd
methods.description: Formats a number as a USD currency string with appropriate decimal places.

methods.name: resolveModelCostConfig
methods.description: Resolves the cost configuration for a given model/provider, considering local cache, configuration, and external pricing.

methods.name: estimateUsageCost
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of usage based on usage metrics and model cost configuration.

methods.name: __resetUsageFormatCachesForTest
methods.description: Resets internal caches for testing purposes.
